posts.name: Livin Nector
posts.cooked:
OPPE 1 - Total marks 100

Note that in OPPE, any method can be used as long as it passes the test cases.

Problem 1 - Data types and expressions [6 x 5 marks = 30 marks]

Six sub-problems (functions) each dealing with one of the below data structure, dealing with basic understanding of each of the data types and applications of it.

  • int and float
  • str
  • list
  • set
  • tuple
  • dict

Problem 2 & 3 - Data processing [2 x 20 marks = 40 marks]

Each will have one function to implement which deals with the below data processing concepts.

  • Data Structures
    • list of items
    • set of items
    • dictionaries
    • list of list
    • dictionary with lists as values
    • dictionary with set as values
    • list of dictionaries
    • Complex nested data structures
  • Data processing techniques
    • aggregation
      • any
      • all
      • sum
      • str.join
      • min
      • max
      • and others
    • filtering
      • if condition
      • comprehensions
      • filter
    • mapping
      • applying transformations or functions
      • comprehensions
      • ternary expression - a if condition else b
      • map
    • groupby
      • grouping using dictionaries
      • processing grouped values
    • Ordering and sorting
      • sorted
      • list.sort - inplace
      • reversed
      • list.reverse - inplace
    • uniques
      • using set
    • Combining multiple techniques

Problem 4 - Input - output based - problem solving [1 x 30 marks = 30 marks]

This will have only one sub-problem where you have to read input from standard input and print the required solution in the standard output. The kind of problem can be anything.
This will require you to

  • Read inputs
  • Solve the problem
  • Print the solution in the expected format

posts.name: Livin Nector
posts.cooked:
• Steady and stable internet connection - This is the most important thing to ensure.
  • Ensure that your laptop is working fine - Ensure that your laptop is working fine, and your account is logged in.
  • Difference between course link and Exam link - OPPE will not be appearing in your usual course link like GrPAs, there will be a different exam link make sure that you use the correct link.
  • Join early to have a peaceful experience - Join early to make sure that you are able to log in and be ready for the exam so that you need not worry about not being able to log in after the exam starts.
  • Use mobile stand - Ensure that you could place your mobile in the mobile stand so that your full body with your laptop screen is visible from the side and there is good lighting in the room.
  • Ensure you have a separate room without any disturbance - This is especially for people who are in joint families, who might not have a separate room. Kindly ensure that you have a separate room at least for the time of the exam.
  • Medical emergencies, internships, collage exams, power cuts and network issues - If you are not able to give the OPPE or write it properly for any reasons that we are not responsible for, you won’t be given any marks or considered for re-OPPE. You should ensure that you are well and available during the exam. If you miss, try to give the OPPE 2 or Repeat the OPPE next term.
